whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Fit Planet Gym,

I noticed your gym has strong 4.4★ reviews from 386+ members on Boring Road, but your current website lacks a seamless mobile experience for trial bookings and batch inquiries.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, exclusive services (Fitplanet Academy & Physiotherapy), aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 http://www.fitplanetgym.com/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Fit Planet Gym, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke gym (Fit Planet Gym Boring Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your core services right on Boring Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual trainer photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
